title: VPN Connection Failures (Error 691)
steps: Verify credentials — error 691 is usually wrong username or password.
Ensure you are using the correct VPN profile (corporate vs. split-tunnel).
Disable any third-party firewalls temporarily and retry.
Flush DNS: run 'ipconfig /flushdns' in an elevated command prompt.
If issue persists, submit ticket with output of 'ipconfig /all'.

title: Outlook Crashes After Windows Update
steps: Open Outlook in safe mode: hold Ctrl while clicking the Outlook icon.
If safe mode works, disable add-ins one by one under File > Options > Add-ins.
Run 'Office Repair' via Control Panel > Programs > Microsoft 365.
If crash persists, collect crash dump from Event Viewer and escalate.

title: Shared Drive Access Request
steps: Manager must submit an access request via the IT portal.
Access is provisioned within one business day of manager approval.
Drive mappings auto-apply at next login; no manual mapping needed.
If drive does not appear after 24 hours, run 'gpupdate /force' and log off/on.

title: Offline Network Printer — Quick Fixes
steps: Check the printer LCD for error messages or paper jams.
Power-cycle the printer (off, wait 30 seconds, on).
Verify the printer IP has not changed — compare to the IT asset register.
Delete and re-add the printer on affected machines if IP changed.
For persistent offline status, escalate to on-site hardware support.

title: Account Lockout and Password Reset
steps: Self-service reset available at password.example.com if MFA is enrolled.
For urgent resets, call the IT hotline: ext. 4357 (HELP).
After reset, update saved credentials in browser and mail clients.
Three or more lockouts in one day triggers a security review.

title: Microsoft Teams Video Quality Issues
steps: Lower Teams video resolution: Settings > Devices > reduce camera resolution.
Check for background applications consuming bandwidth.
Switch to wired Ethernet if on Wi-Fi.
Update Teams to the latest version via Help > Check for updates.
If on VPN, try split-tunnel mode to reduce video traffic through the tunnel.
